L0: # Skills for agents
L1: 
L2: Install instructions that help AI agents create more accurate Stripe integrations.
L3: 
L4: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L5: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L6: 
L7: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L8: 
L9: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L10: [Agent skills](https://agentskills.io/home) give AI coding agents reusable guidance for building Stripe integrations. Stripe-maintained skills provide the newest product and API guidance based on the latest recommended practices.
L11: ## Install skills with a plugin (Recommended)
L12: 
L13: [Agent plugins](https://docs.stripe.com/agents/plugin.md) for Stripe automatically configure the Stripe MCP server, install our skills, and make sure they’re up-to-date. You get our latest capabilities without configuration or maintenance.
L14: 
L15: ```bash
L16: npm install -g @stripe/cli@latest
L17: stripe agent setup
L18: ```
L19: 
L20: This command automatically detects which agents you use, and runs the applicable commands.
L21: ## Manually install agent skills
L22: 
L23: Alternatively, run the following command to install Stripe skills manually. You also needs to regularly update the skills to get the latest versions.
L24: 
L25: ```bash
L26: npx skills add https://docs.stripe.com
L27: ```
L28: 
L29: > Manually installed skills don’t auto-update. Run `npx skills update -y` to get the latest versions.
L30: To access live Stripe account data, also [set up the Stripe MCP](https://docs.stripe.com/mcp.md#manual) server. Together, Stripe MCP and skills provide capabilities similar to the plugin, but you must configure and maintain them separately. Vendor-specific plugin features, such as lifecycle hooks, aren’t available.
L31: ## Skills index
L32: 
L33: See the [index of Stripe skills](https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/index.json.md).
L34: 
L35: If `npx skills` isn’t available: You can use curl to fetch the index of available skills, what they do, and their files from `https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/index.json`. To download a skill and its related files, use curl to download them from `https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/<filepath>`.
